definitions.short: Ammiel , the name of three or four Israelites
definitions.full: H5988. Ammiel עַמִּיאֵל proper name, masculine ( my kinsman is God , Gray Prop. N. 254 ); — ᵐ5 Αμος ( με ) ιηλ : 1 east Jordan name 2Sam 9:4-5 , 17:27 . 2 a Danite Num 13:12 (P). 3 David's father-in-law 1Chr 3:5 (= אֱלִיעָם 2Sam 11:3 ). 4 son of Obed Edom 1Chr 26:5 .
